mentions.name: Save My Music
mentions.description: This webapp keeps track of a user's playlists and notifies them when a song is silently removed by a streaming service.
mentions.problem: Streaming services like Spotify silently remove tracks from playlists when they lose the rights, with no notification, so songs just disappear.
mentions.audience: Music listeners who use streaming services and want to protect their personal playlists
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a webapp to keep track of your playlists and notify you when a song disappears
